_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: "The input" is the message input [data-testid="message-input"]; "the send button" is [data-testid="send-button"]; "the chevron" is the send options button [data-testid="send-options-button"]; "the thinking indicator" is [data-testid="agent-thinking"]; "the Stop button" is button[aria-label="Stop"]; "queued badges" are [data-testid="queued-badge"]. "Tap X" means a touch step "start" on X immediately followed by a touch step "end" (a tap, not a click). "Send X and wait for work" means: fill the input with X; the send button should become enabled (up to 5s); tap it; the thinking indicator should become visible (up to 30s). "Queue X" means: fill the input with X; the chevron should be enabled and visible (up to 5s each); tap it; the queue option [data-testid="queue-option"] should become visible (up to 5s); tap it. Every test starts: navigate to /c/queue and wait (up to 30s) for the input to be visible. window.textCount(text) counts the innermost elements whose text contains text, ignoring case; window.textCount(text, true) counts those whose whole text is exactly text. Cancelling a queued message puts it back in an empty composer, and the server forgets it. Call "cancel-queued answered" reports how many requests to /cancel-queued the server has answered with 200. 1. Navigate to /c/queue and wait for the input. 2. Send "delay: 60" and wait for work. 3. Queue "echo: to be cancelled". 4. A queued badge should become visible (up to 10s). 5. The cancel button [data-testid="cancel-queued"] should be visible. 6. Call "cancel-queued answered"; it must be "0". 7. Tap the cancel button. 8. Call "cancel-queued answered"; it should become "1" (up to 10s). 9. The input's value should be exactly "echo: to be cancelled". 10. Reload the page (the stream only sends metadata for the deletion) and wait (up to 30s) for the input to be visible. 11. There should be no queued badge (count 0, up to 10s). 12. Nothing on the page may contain "to be cancelled" any more: eval window.textCount("to be cancelled") with expect "0" (up to 10s).
